project_name: Anjana Sara Abraham - Executive Business Analysis & Transformation Portfolio
summary: Award-worthy single-page portfolio for Anjana Sara Abraham, blending high-end editorial publication aesthetics with strategic consulting rigor. Features deep obsidian-navy base, balanced blue/teal/lavender/warm-ochre accents, strong left-aligned asymmetry, masked kinetic hero typography, numbered manifesto chapters, and deliberate asset segregation between real professional portraits and generative technical diagrams.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this design_guidelines.json completely before modifying any code.
Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', 'Arial' for any headings or display text. Use 'Playfair Display' for headlines and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body and analytical UI.
Keep the primary background deep obsidian-navy (#090D16) with #0E1626 card surfaces and subtle 1px border strokes (border-white/10). Avoid generic full-screen gradients.
Implement the kinetic line-by-line masked text reveal in the hero using Framer Motion.
Implement the slow editorial marquee ribbon with continuous momentum.
Place the user's real professional portrait in the Hero Sidecar Card and Executive Profile section with high-contrast frame styling.
Use interactive SVG and data visualization components for the Transformation Manifesto chapters and Diagnostic Readiness Calculator.
All interactive elements, buttons, links, inputs, and major chapter headers MUST include their corresponding data-testid attribute as defined in this document.
Use Sonner toast notifications for the consultation inquiry form feedback.
Ensure total responsiveness from 360px mobile to 4K ultra-wide monitors.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Never use centered cookie-cutter layouts or random tech gradients. Maintain strong left-aligned asymmetry and deliberate editorial tension.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Never use 'transition: all'. Apply explicit transitions like 'transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous breathing room: p-6 to p-10 on cards, gap-8 to gap-16 between sections.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 minimum). Always specify explicit text colors for :hover and :focus states.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_assistant_emojis: Never use emoji characters like 🤖🧠💡🔮 for UI icons. Use Phosphor, Lucide, or Radix UI icons instead.
